title: Learning and Control Beyond Linearity: Towards a Non-asymptotic Theory for Bilinear Systems
summary: This tutorial provides a unified view of the emerging area of bilinear learning and control. Using linear systems as a benchmark, it explains what fundamentally changes in the bilinear settings, how recent theory addresses finite-sample learning and control, and how these ideas connect to broader themes in nonlinear control, representation learning, and data-driven decision making.
